payload.title: welcome banner shows the correct signed-in user's name
payload.errorMessage:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('welcome-banner')
Expected: "Welcome, Priya"
Received: "Welcome, Alex"

note: A wrong username in a welcome banner reads like a serious session-mixup bug, not a flake. But retried-and-passed plus a low, steady historical rate across 45 runs point to a client-side session-cache read racing the fresh-login response — the previous test worker's cached user object is read once before the new session settles, then self-corrects. A one-shot read alone would call this REAL_BUG and could trigger a false security-adjacent alarm.
